study: Capsule Review — frozen original blood CNN transfer audit on newly acquired Galar fitting examinations
status: Frozen before first score computation; images and source labels have already been acquired and inspected for fitting-candidate selection. This is not a blinded preregistration.
study_role: Descriptive transfer assessment of an unchanged historical model; fitting-candidate data only, not independent clinical evaluation
source_labels: Official corrected Galar v2 blood=0/1 annotation. Zero does not mean absence of other clinical pathology.

historical_frozen_cnn.model: Original compact two-output capsule-cnn-v1 blood annotation classifier trained 1–8, historical checkpoint selected on inspected 9–10
historical_frozen_cnn.architecture: 3 convolutional blocks Conv3x3 stride2 3->16->32->64; each followed by GroupNorm4/ReLU; AdaptiveAvgPool2d1, Linear64->2
historical_frozen_cnn.preprocess: PIL EXIF transpose; RGB; ImageOps.pad to 96x96, bilinear, black padding; [0,1] float32 CHW; no augmentation
historical_frozen_cnn.inference: torch no-grad eval float32 CPU; softmax class1; no fitting, weight updates, hyperparameter or model selection

comparators.red_excess: Original fixed blood-pilot red-excess score (96x96 central crop and same arithmetic); no post hoc color heuristic adjustment
comparators.uniform: Deterministic uniform position selection on the sorted 512 reference images within each examination at each budget
comparators.budget_rule: floor(n*percent/100) selected per exam, model sorted by descending score then increasing source index; same k for red and deterministic-uniform comparators

primary_evaluation.cohort: Exactly 512 previously selected label-blind reference images per examination (21,23,30), not enriched fitting-only samples
primary_evaluation.unit: examination ID, not confirmed unique patient
outcomes: per-examination ROC-AUC when positive and negative support exist
blood-labelled image hits at each budget
primary_evaluation.important_caution: Exam21 has only 1 blood-positive reference frame and exam23 only 4. Per-exam AUC/AP and top-k are extremely unstable; report all individual positive counts and do not infer population performance.

secondary_evaluation.cohort: All 993+1001+1006=3000 selected unique images (mix of enriched-fitting and uniform-reference images) per exam
secondary_evaluation.interpretation: Descriptive only; positive-label enrichment substantially changes prevalence and selection mechanism, so pooled AP/recall is not natural-case prevalence or clinical validity.

strict_separation.disallowed_ids: historical model fitting examinations 1–8, inspected development 9–10, reserved future evaluation 11–20, source-author holdout 61–80
strict_separation.outcome_use: Do not tune/update the frozen original model based on these outcomes; new training candidates need inner examination-held-out validation and future locked evaluation

artifact_policy: Commit frozen spec, independent code/tests and aggregate results only. Save per-image scores and medical pixels with original identities privately in Capsule Review Library.
patient_data: Only deidentified permitted research sources; no Xona confidential computing or PHI
stop_policy: Abort if any model hash, image/private manifest hash, source label identity, 512-reference count, or original source-frame name integrity fails. Do not reinterpret unknown labels as negatives.
